title: Human Colon Tissue Clearing and Immunohistochemistry
author: Robert Heuckeroth
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wyeffte

steps.title: Transport tissue on ice
steps.instruction: Place freshly resected human colon tissue in cold sterile 1X PBS on ice and transport to the lab within 1–2 hours of resection.

steps.title: Place tissue in Sylgard dish
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue with forceps into a Sylgard™‑coated dish containing fresh PBS, lay it flat with the luminal side down and the serosa side up.

steps.title: Remove surrounding fat
steps.instruction: Using dissecting scissors and forceps, trim away any adipose tissue and discard it according to biosafety guidelines.

steps.title: Pin and stretch tissue
steps.instruction: Pin one edge of the tissue, stretch it uniformly by repositioning pins several times until the specimen is flat; typical stretch expands the area ≈2.6‑fold.

steps.title: Fix tissue with PFA
steps.instruction: Remove PBS, add 4 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) to fully cover the tissue, and incubate at 4 °C overnight.

steps.title: Cut staining strip
steps.instruction: Using small dissecting scissors, cut a full‑thickness strip ≈1 cm × 1 cm for staining; place remaining tissue in a storage solution of 50 % 1X PBS, 50 % glycerol, 0.05 % sodium azide and keep at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash stored tissue
steps.instruction: Remove storage solution, then wash the strip three times in 1X PBS for 5 min each wash in a 24‑well plate (≈500 µL per well) on a moderate‑speed rocker at room temperature.

steps.title: Methanol pre‑treatment
steps.instruction: Incubate the tissue in 100 % methanol for 1 h on ice (≈500 µL per well, rocker at room temperature).

steps.title: Permeabilize with Dent’s Bleach
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue to Dent’s Bleach (5 mL 30 % H₂O₂ + 5 mL DMSO + 20 mL 100 % methanol) for 2 h at room temperature.

steps.title: PBS washes after bleach
steps.instruction: Wash tissue three times in 1X PBS for 5 min each (≈500 µL per well, rocker at room temperature).

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate tissue in Blocking Solution (4 % normal donkey serum in 0.5 % PBS‑T; PBS‑T = 0.5 % Triton X‑100 in 1X PBS with 0.05 % sodium azide) for 3 days at room temperature. Perform the incubation in 24‑well plates with ≈500 µL per well on a moderate‑speed rocker, or in 2 mL Eppendorf tubes on a shaker at 40–100 rpm (still at room temperature).

steps.title: Remove pins and trim edges
steps.instruction: Replace the 4 % PFA with fresh PBS, carefully remove all pins, and trim excess tissue edges.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Dilute primary antibody in the same Blocking Solution and incubate tissue for 14 days at 37 °C. Place samples in airtight sealed tubes, seal additionally with Parafilm™ and keep on a shaker at 40–100 rpm to ensure full coverage.

steps.title: Post‑primary washes
steps.instruction: Wash tissue three times in 1X PBS containing 0.05 % sodium azide for 2 h per wash, then leave the specimen in the same buffer overnight at room temperature on a moderate‑speed rocker.

substeps.instruction: Overnight incubation in 1X PBS + 0.05 % sodium azide at room temperature

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate tissue in secondary antibody diluted in 1X PBS with 0.05 % sodium azide for 3 days at 37 °C (same tube/shaker conditions as primary).

steps.title: Post‑secondary washes
steps.instruction: Wash tissue three times in 1X PBS + 0.05 % sodium azide for 2 h per wash, then leave overnight in the same buffer at room temperature on a rocker.

substeps.instruction: Overnight incubation in 1X PBS + 0.05 % sodium azide at room temperature

steps.title: Methanol dehydration series
steps.instruction: Dehydrate tissue sequentially in methanol at room temperature on a rocker:

steps.title: Clear tissue in Murray’s Clear
steps.instruction: Transfer tissue directly from 100 % methanol into Murray’s Clear (2 : 1 benzyl benzoate : benzyl alcohol) until fully transparent; clearing time varies with specimen thickness.

steps.title: Mount cleared tissue
steps.instruction: Mount the transparent tissue on glass slides using Murray’s Clear as mounting medium. For inverted confocal imaging, tape a coverslip at the slide edges and add only a minimal amount of Murray’s Clear.

steps.title: Acquire images
steps.instruction: Image the cleared colon using confocal or light‑sheet microscopy (e.g., Zeiss LSM 710/750). Use 10× or 20× Plan‑Apochromat objectives with Zeiss Zen software (v2.3 14.0.14.201). Set Z‑axis increments to 4 µm (10×) or 1 µm (20×). Capture 10× Z‑stacks (900 × 900 px) and stitch for large regions; acquire high‑resolution 20× stacks (1200 × 1200 px) by imaging myenteric and submucosal plexi separately (turn tissue over). Use 100 % laser power with the following filter sets: Alexa 647 (exc 633 nm, em 656‑755 nm), Alexa 594 (exc 561 nm, em 588‑656 nm), Alexa 488 (exc 488 nm, em 493‑584 nm).
